Use when Codex faces a long or multi-part task, work that has returned half-done, an exhaustive audit or build, parallel leaves or pipelines, or explicit triggers such as /unlazy, $unlazy, "tree N", "gates", and "do not stop until it is done".

skills.name: update-cli-config
skills.description: View and modify Codex CLI configuration settings in ~/.cursor/cli-config.json. Use when the user wants to change CLI settings, configure permissions, switch approval mode, enable vim mode, toggle display options, configure sandbox, or manage any CLI preferences.

skills.name: update-cursor-settings
skills.description: Modify Codex/VSCode user settings in settings.json. Use when you want to change editor settings, preferences, configuration, themes, font size, tab size, format on save, auto save, keybindings, or any settings.json values.

skills.name: wait-what
skills.description: "Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it."

skills.name: watch
skills.description: Watch and understand footage with Diffusion Studio via the `dapi` CLI: answer questions about a video or audio file, summarize it, find scenes and moments, pull quotes, and describe what happens and when. Use whenever the user asks what's in a piece of footage, wants a summary or recap, wants to locate a moment ("where does X happen", "find the scene where..."), or needs a claim about a video or audio file checked.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.description: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.

skills.name: web-perf
skills.description: Analyzes web performance using Chrome DevTools MCP. Measures Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and supplementary metrics (FCP, TBT, Speed Index), identifies render-blocking resources, network dependency chains, layout shifts, caching issues, and accessibility gaps. Use when asked to audit, profile, debug, or optimize page load performance, Lighthouse scores, or site speed. Biases towards retrieval from current documentation over pre-trained knowledge.

skills.name: wizard
skills.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.

skills.name: workers-best-practices
skills.description: Reviews and authors Cloudflare Workers code against production best practices. Load when writing new Workers, reviewing Worker code, configuring wrangler.jsonc, or checking for common Workers anti-patterns (streaming, floating promises, global state, secrets, bindings, observability). Biases towards retrieval from Cloudflare docs over pre-trained knowledge.

skills.name: wrangler
skills.description: Cloudflare Workers CLI for deploying, developing, and managing Workers, KV, R2, D1, Vectorize, Hyperdrive, Workers AI, Containers, Queues, Workflows, Pipelines, and Secrets Store. Load before running wrangler commands to ensure correct syntax and best practices. Biases towards retrieval from Cloudflare docs over pre-trained knowledge.

skills.name: write-swift
skills.description: How to write modern Swift well — modeling with value types, Swift 6 data-race safety and approachable concurrency (@concurrent, main-actor-by-default, actors, task groups), protocols and generics (some vs any), API design, performance and ARC, Swift Testing, macros, and the modern language features agents don't know about yet. Use when writing, reviewing, or migrating Swift, or when a concurrency error, a hang, a data race, a retain cycle, or a performance problem needs fixing.

skills.name: writing-beats
skills.description: Writing, exploit; assemble raw material into a journey of beats, grounding each term before a beat leans on it.

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.

skills.name: writing-fragments
skills.description: "Writing, explore: mine raw fragments, no structure yet."

skills.name: writing-shape
skills.description: "Writing, exploit: shape raw material into an article, paragraph by paragraph."
